title: Atinamos MCP Buyer Policy v1
description: Caller-supplied procurement policy accepted by the Atinamos Evidence MCP evaluate_policy tool.

require_known.description: Require the service to be represented in the published Atinamos evidence corpus.

minimum_successful_fulfilments.description: Minimum number of published successful fulfilments required.

maximum_failed_fulfilments.description: Maximum number of published failed fulfilments permitted.

require_paid_evidence.description: Require at least one published paid test.

max_evidence_age_days.description: Maximum age in days of the latest published verification timestamp.

max_price_usdc.description: Maximum permitted observed USDC price from the latest published observation when available.
